jobs.description:
For one of our clients, we are looking for experienced Business Analysts to support digital transformation initiatives within the Assets Department.

In this role, you will contribute to strategic digitalisation and optimisation projects designed to improve the efficiency, safety, and reliability of the organisation's operations.

As a key liaison between business stakeholders and IT teams, you will analyse and redesign business processes, gather and validate requirements, and ensure that digital solutions effectively support operational needs.

You will also contribute to the energy transition, renewable energy integration, and the harmonisation of processes across different entities.

Key responsibilities

 
• Business analysis & process optimisation:
  
   
• Analyse, model, and optimise business processes.
   
• Guide business stakeholders in redesigning and improving operational processes.
   
• Gather business needs and translate them into epics, user stories, and business requirements.
   
• Constructively challenge stakeholders to ensure efficient and pragmatic solutions.
   
• Develop business information models to support the implementation of requirements.
   
• Support the harmonisation of processes across departments and entities.
  
 
• Business & IT coordination:
  
   
• Facilitate the alignment and validation of requirements between business and IT teams.
   
• Review and validate functional analyses prepared by IT partners.
   
• Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders throughout project delivery.
   
• Ensure digital solutions effectively address identified business and operational needs.
  
 
• Testing & implementation:
  
   
• Test, review, and validate application releases following implementation.
   
• Support business users during the implementation of new solutions.
   
• Provide post-implementation support to business users.
  
 
• Change management & user support:
  
   
• Contribute to change management activities.
   
• Prepare training materials.
   
• Deliver end-user training sessions.
   
• Support users during adoption and post-go-live phases.
  
 
• Projects may involve:
  
   
• Digitalisation and optimisation of outage-planning processes for maintenance activities.
   
• Automation and digitalisation of switching operations in the high-voltage network.
   
• Improvement of operational safety processes and supporting ICT applications.
   
• Development of processes and systems supporting offshore wind infrastructure maintenance.
   
• Optimisation of administrative support processes for operational departments, particularly within SAP PM.
   
• Other digital transformation and process optimisation initiatives within the Assets organisation.
  

Ideal candidate

 
• The ideal candidate is an experienced Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business and IT while driving transformation initiatives in a complex operational environment.
 
• You combine strong analytical skills with excellent stakeholder-management capabilities and are comfortable challenging existing processes to deliver sustainable improvements.
 
• Experience in infrastructure, utilities, energy, or asset-intensive industries is highly valued.

Professional & soft skills:

 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  
 
• Critical thinker with the confidence to challenge assumptions.
  
 
• Excellent stakeholder-management skills.
  
 
• Strong communication and presentation abilities.
  
 
• Customer-focused approach.
...

• Mandatory requirements: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst.

• Proven experience in:

• Requirements gathering and analysis

• Business process design and optimisation

• Business requirements documentation

• Stakeholder management

• Master's degree in an Engineering, Technical, Economic, or related field, or equivalent experience.

• Fluent communication skills in:

• Dutch

• French

• English

• Strong knowledge of:

• BPMN

• UML

• Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills.

• Strong communication and facilitation abilities.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary environments.

• Strong planning, organisational, and coordination skills.

• Strong assets: Basic knowledge of SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) or willingness to acquire it quickly.

• Experience with:

• Enterprise Architect (EA)

• Jira

• Azure DevOps / TFS

• Experience in the electricity, utilities, or energy sector.

• Experience with industrial asset maintenance and asset management processes.

• Exposure to large-scale digital transformation or business process optimisation projects.

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Experienced Project Manager (IT Infrastructure Projects)
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 27.000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Job Description

 
• As our Project Manager, you'll be the driving force behind a wide range of impactful infrastructure projects.
 
• You take the lead in shaping solid project plans, managing timelines, and tracking budgets while keeping a sharp eye on risks, issues, and scope.
 
• You'll guide and motivate your team, ensure quality at every step, and keep all stakeholders — internal, external, and third parties — well aligned through clear communication and reporting.
 
• You also play a key role in preparing and facilitating working groups and steering committees, ensuring decisions are well supported and documented.
 
• In addition, you support our presales activities: coordinating complex tender responses, contributing to estimates, evaluating project‑related components, and identifying risks early on.
 
• If you enjoy combining structure with collaboration and love seeing a project through from idea to execution, this role is for you.

Additional information

 
• A high-impact role where you take ownership of complex infrastructure projects that shape customer success and business outcomes.
 
• A workplace that invests in you, offering training opportunities, certifications, and support to further develop your project management and technical skills.
 
• The chance to coach and mentor junior project managers, helping them grow while strengthening your own leadership capabilities.
 
• Variety in your work: you'll collaborate with different customers across diverse industries and environments, giving you broad exposure and constant learning opportunities.
 
• Autonomy and trust to drive decisions, manage your team, and shape project execution in a way that aligns with your expertise.
 
• Collaboration with strong technical teams — engineers, analysts, architects — giving you a chance to deepen your understanding of ICT infrastructure and operational practices.
 
• Career growth paths, whether toward senior project leadership, program management, or specialized technology domains.
 
• A supportive PM community, encouraging knowledge sharing, best practices, and continuous improvement.
 
• A culture that values initiative and ownership, where your ideas to improve processes or customer experience are truly heard.
 
• A competitive and extensive remuneration package, including:
  
   
• Company car
   
• Meal vouchers
   
• Medical insurance
   
• Group insurance
   
• And other attractive benefits
  
 
• The opportunity to make a...

You are someone who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen. To succeed in this role, you bring:

• At least 3 years of experience managing projects of 100 man-days or more

• A solid understanding of ICT, both functionally and technically

• 
Familiarity with key technical concepts such as:

Operating systems, server platforms, Storage, networking, security, 3‑tier architecture, collaboration tools, application delivery, and management systems

You will be the analytical engine behind our clients' most challenging impurity investigations. You will design and execute highly sensitive mass spectrometry methods to ensure the safety and compliance of pharmaceutical products.
 
 

• Design, develop and validate sensitive and robust analytical methods for trace-level analysis quantification (with a primary focus on nitrosamine and NDSRI’s) using LC-MS/MS and HRMS, in compliance with ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines.  

• Perform complex sample preparation and analysis in diverse pharmaceutical matrices, applying expertise in mass spectrometry (Triple Quadrupole, HRMS), chromatographic separation (UHPLC) and sample preparation.  

• Design robust extraction and sample clean-up strategies (e.g., SPE, liquid-liquid extraction) to overcome severe matrix effects in complex drug products, while strictly preventing artifact generation during analysis. 

• Conduct and support root cause investigations related to impurity formation, focusing on chemical pathways, impurity profiling, and risk assessment across drug substance and drug product development.  

• Deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards. Contribute to method transfer and GMP documentation.  

• Promote innovation by exploring novel analytical approaches and emerging technologies to enhance detection limits and method robustness.  

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• Interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects.
  

• Represent Anabiotec/anacura in internal and external scientific forums and scientific conferences. 
 

• PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry (or a closely) related scientific field) or Master degree with at least 6 years of relevant industry experience.  

• Minimum of 4–6 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical R&D or analytical services.  

• Proven experience in LC-MS trace analysis in drug substances, drug products, or excipients is a strong asset.  

• Extensive practical knowledge of mass spectrometry (QqQ and orbitrap) and chromatography.  

• Experience in method development, validation, and transfer under GMP conditions.  

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (ICH Q2, Q3, FDA/EMA guidance on nitrosamines) and GMP principles.  

• Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) is required for high-quality scientific reporting. 

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Capable of prioritizing tasks across multiple urgent client projects in a dynamic CRO environment.

We are looking for a Mendix Low-Code Expert to join a major international IT project within a European institutional environment in Brussels.

You will be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining secure, scalable and accessible business applications using Mendix. Working within an Agile and multidisciplinary environment, you will collaborate with business analysts, UX/UI specialists, testers and project teams to transform business requirements into robust digital solutions.

The role also involves enterprise integrations, application security, reusable components, testing, deployment and production support.

Your Role:

As a Mendix Low-Code Expert, you will:

• Translate business requirements and user stories into robust Mendix applications.
• Design domain models, workflows, user interfaces and application security roles.
• Develop integrations with internal and external systems using REST APIs, database connectors and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
• Work with authentication technologies such as SAML and OIDC.
• Develop reusable Mendix modules, widgets and components.
• Contribute to shared development standards and best practices.
• Apply secure-by-design principles, role-based access control and data-protection requirements.
• Develop accessible interfaces in line with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
• Write unit and automated tests and participate in code reviews.
• Monitor application quality and contribute to the management of technical debt.
• Support deployments, release management and third-level production support.
• Produce and maintain technical documentation.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Mendix development practices. 
The Profile We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a highly experienced Mendix Developer / Low-Code Expert with a strong software-development background and proven experience delivering enterprise applications.

You should have:

• At least 5 years of IT development experience.
• At least 3 years of hands-on Mendix development experience.
• Mendix Advanced Developer certification or higher.
• Experience delivering at least two Mendix applications into production.
• Practical experience with Mendix 10 or later.
• Experience integrating Mendix applications with enterprise systems.
• Experience with on-premises and/or private-cloud environments.
• Working knowledge of Java and JavaScript, particularly for custom Mendix actions, widgets or extensions.
• Experience working in Scrum or another Agile development framework.
• Strong understanding of application security, testing, integration, maintainability and software-development best practices.
• English at C1 level.
Key Skills:

• Mendix 10+
• Low-Code Application Development
• Domain Modelling
• Microflows / Application Workflows
• REST APIs & Enterprise Integrations
• SAML / OIDC
• Role-Based Access Control
• Java
• JavaScript
• Application Security
• Testing & Quality Assurance
• Production Support
• Agile / Scrum
• Technical Documentation
• WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility
Desired Qualifications:

The following would be considered strong advantages:

• Mendix Expert Developer certification.
• Experience working within a European institution, public administration or other large-scale public-sector environment.
• Experience with Mendix AI capabilities, including GenAI connectors or Maia.
• Experience leading or contributing to complex enterprise Mendix implementations.
• Experience developing reusable Mendix components and shared application libraries. 
Additional Information

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Working regime: Full-time
• Environment: International and multicultural
• Language: English C1 required; French is considered an advantage
• Work arrangement: Brussels-based; specific on-site/teleworking arrangements will be communicated during the recruitment process.
What We Offer:

Joining Alsena means contributing to high-impact international IT projects within a complex and multicultural environment.

You will have the opportunity to work on large-scale digital solutions, strengthen your expertise in Mendix, low-code development, enterprise integrations, application security and cloud environments, and contribute to modern applications used in a demanding institutional context.

You will work alongside experienced technical professionals while gaining exposure to complex enterprise systems and modern software-development practices.

Digitribe is looking for a Programme Management Officer (PMO) to join a large-scale cloud transformation programme at one of our clients, a major player in the financial services sector. The programme covers several streams: cloud migrations, technology foundations, cloud risk and resilience, non-technology foundations (people, process, FinOps), strategic cloud use cases and partner governance. • Produce monthly and quarterly reporting for the executive committee, the CIO, steering committees and sponsors

• Consolidate budgets, forecasts and actuals, and flag funding gaps and resourcing risks

• Build and maintain the end-to-end business case: investments, TCO, run costs, benefits, savings, and scenario and sensitivity analysis

• Track benefits and value realisation: migration progress, cloud adoption, cost savings, risk reduction

• Perform delivery health checks and challenge status and evidence

• Coordinate evidence for internal audit and regulatory reviews, including DORA

• Track commitments and joint initiatives with strategic technology partners

• 8+ years in programme management, PMO or portfolio governance within a large, complex organisation

• Proven ownership of integrated planning, RAID processes, executive reporting and dependency management

• Strong financial management skills: budgets, forecasts, actuals, investment reporting

• Hands-on experience building business cases for large IT or cloud programmes, including TCO, benefits quantification and scenario analysis

• Experience in financial services or another regulated environment

• Cloud transformation experience is a strong plus, ideally on Azure, including FinOps and partner governance

• Experience with audit and regulatory evidence (DORA) and with PPM tooling or dashboards is a plus

• MSP, PMP, Prince2, MOP, P3O or SAFe certifications are a plus

• Fluent English; French and/or Dutch is a plus
